description.value:
You feel more at home in the cold hum of a ship's corridors than on any planet's surface. Most of your life has passed between stars, and whatever your job aboard — pilot, mechanic, support crew, or something else — you picked up a working understanding of how a ship holds together.

You know the safe hyperlanes from the dangerous ones, you can name a hull design at a glance, and you still catch yourself missing the low thrum of a drive at rest.

toolProficiencies: Your choice of chef's kit, mechanic's kit, or one type of gaming set
system.equipment: A set of tools or a gaming set of your choice, a set of common clothes, a small souvenir from your travels, and a belt pouch containing 100 credits.
